title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
snippet: As it turns out, utf8 is a deprecated alias for utf8mb3 which is not all of UTF-8: it only supports 1-3 bytes per Unicode code point, while full UTF-8 has a max of 4 bytes per code point. To get all of UTF-8, we needed to change our handshake to use utf8mb4 , which fixed the emoji issue.
